description_en: This four bayedPhalcāmakes up the ground floor of a north-facing Sataḥ. The upper floor of the Phalcā has plain windows. Its eastern part is used by the Sanāḥ Guṭhī to store firewood necessary for the funeral for the residents living in this Ṭola where the Phalcā is located. A historicaljaḥdhuṃhiti(cf.Furukawa2010, 80) stands to the western side.A television set is kept on the Phalcā’s first floor in 2014 CE to entertain local elderly residents. There is anāsaḥdyaḥ’sshrine on the upper level of the Sataḥ. The tradition of worshipping and consecrating thenāsaḥdyaḥin the training centre within the HakaṬola during musical instrument training is still ongoing. Previously, the upper floor was utilised by Śramajita Pustakālaya since 1970 CE (VS 2027) as a library. Two other organisations, Yuvā Vistāra Samiti and Hakatvāḥ Macā Pucaḥ jointly used the space in tandem. All of these three organisations are currently defunct.There is no evidence to date the initial construction of the Sataḥ. The inscription from 1762 CE (NS 883) mentions a Brahmin woman endowing some plots of paddy field to aguṭhīto appease Lakṣmīnārāyaṇa. At present (October 2020) no statue of Lakṣmīnārāyaṇa can be found in the Sataḥ. Hence it is unclear whether this inscription is related to this monument or brought here from another place. If it is indeed related to the Sataḥ, then it can be attested that the Sataḥ was in existence in the 18th century. During the reconstruction, newer wooden elements were used and the older timber posts were not safely stored or kept (source: Local resident, Maharjana, male, age 62). As there are not historical materials, it is difficult to ascertain the origin of the Sataḥ. Its roof was damaged in the 2015 CE earthquakes and is now (October 2020 CE) being reconstructed.
description_ne: हकटोलबाट लुखुसितिर लाग्ने चोकको पूर्वतिर यो सतः अवस्थित छ । स्थानीयले यसलाई 'नासःचपाः' भन्दै आएका छन् । उत्तराभिमुख सतःको भूमि तल्लामा चार कवलको फल्चा छ । फल्चाभन्दा माथि थप एक तल्ला उठाइएको छ जहाँ सामान्य काष्ठझ्यालहरू हालिएका छन् । भूमि तल्लाको पूर्वी खण्ड सना:गुठीले टोलका मृत सदस्यको दाहा संस्कार गरिँदा प्रयोग हुने दाउरा भण्डारणको निम्ति प्रयोग गर्दै आएको छ । भूमि तल्लाकै पश्चिमी भित्तासंग गाभेर ठुलो आकारको जःह्रुंहिति स्थापित छ जुन  मध्यकालीन हो (Furukawa2010, 80) ।भूमि तल्लामा भएको फल्चामा नियमित भजन वा अन्य सांस्कृतिक गतिविधि नभएकाले फल्चाको सदुपयोग गर्दै बृद्धबृद्धाको मनोरञ्जनका निम्ति सन् 2014 देखि  टिभी (television) जडान गरिएको छ (Local resident, Maharjana, male, age 65) । सतःको माथिल्लो तल्लमा नासःद्यःको देवस्थल (shrien) छ । हकटोलभित्र जुन स्थानमा बाद्यबादन प्रशिक्षण गरिए तापनि यही नासःद्यःको प्राण साधना गरी प्रशिक्षण कक्षमा स्थापना गर्न लानुपर्ने चलन यद्यपि चली आएको छ । सन् 1970 (VS 2027)  देखि 'श्रमजित पुस्तकालय'को नामबाट सत:को माथिल्लो तल्लालाई पुस्तकालयको रूप दिइएको छ । त्यसैगरी 'युवा विस्तार समिति' र 'हकत्वाः मचा पुचः' नामक सामाजिक संस्थाहरूले पनि सतःको माथिल्लो तल्ला आपसी साझेदारीमा कार्यालयको रूपमा प्रयोग गर्दै आएको छ । हाल यी तीनै संस्था निस्कृय अवस्थामा छन् ।यो सतःको निर्माणमिति निश्चय गर्न सकिने कुनै अभिलेख सतःमा पाइँदैन । सतःको भित्तामा सन् १७६२ (नेसं ८८३) को  अभिलेख टाँसिएको छ जसमा लक्ष्मीनारायणलाई प्रसन्न पार्न भनी एक ब्राह्मणीले गुठीलाई खेत चढाएको प्रसंग छ । हाल सतःभित्र कुनै लक्ष्मीनारायणको मूर्ति नभएबाट यो अभिलेख यसै सतःसंग सम्बन्धित हो वा अन्त कतैबाट यहाँ ल्याई राखिएको हो भन्ने कुरा स्पष्ट छैन । यदि सतःसंगै सम्बन्धित हो भने सतः १८ औं शदी मै अस्तित्वमा रहेको मान्नु पर्ने हुन्छ । सन् १९९८ मा सतः पुनःनिर्माण गरिँदा नयाँ काष्ठ सामग्री प्रयोग गरिएकाले सतःमा विगत हुने गरेका पुराना थामो लगाएत अन्य निर्माण सामग्रीहरू सुरक्षित हुन सकेनन् (Local resident, Maharjana, male, age 62) । यसरी ऐतिहासिक निर्माण सामग्री नबचेकाले पनि सतःको ऐतिहासिकता निर्धारण गर्न कठिन बनेको छ । सन् २०१५ को भूकम्पले क्षति पुगेका कारण हाल (सन् २०२० मा) सतःको छानो सम्मको भाग भत्काई पुनःनिर्माण कार्य भैरहेको छ ।

historical_events.event_description: The Sataḥ was completely dismantled and rebuilt withmāaḥpā(bricks of relatively large size) and new columns.
The roof of the Sataḥ was seriously damaged during the 2015 earthquakes.

A historical Jadhuṃhiti was placed on the western side of the Sataḥ. Previously, this water diviner was attached to Nāsaḥ Capāḥ. But when the Phalcā was dismantled in 2013 CE and incorporated in a large four-storied concrete structure, the Jadhuṃhiti was kept there depreciatingly until its shift. This activity was undertaken by the joint effort of Lalitpur Metropolitan City, Hakatvāḥ Mankāḥ Khalaḥ and Śaharī Garibaharūko Lāgi Samāja.
As of October 2020, the roof of the Sataḥ is under reconstruction. A local committee is managing the project with funding from the Lalitpur Metropolitan City.

historical_events.event_name: Renovation of the Caitya (B) (the object number LAL4066-007)
historical_events.event_description: Punasiṃ, Āsācā, Dhanarā, Tavadhika and others jointly commission the renovation of the Caitya.

Probably, this inscription does not belong to this Sataḥ, despite being embedded in its facade. It says that in the name of late Raghunātha Ujhā, Sundarī Brāhmaṇī 6ropanīsof land were granted from an area calledNhulakvāṭha. It also records the regulations for organising different religious events forthe Patan Kumārī.
Dedicated to the Buddha, tiles have been paved in front of the Sataḥ by Lalita Bhāva and Najani Mayi.

historical_events.event_name: Renovation of the Caitya (A) (the object number LAL4066-007)
historical_events.event_description: The Caitya was renovated. At the same time, Nārāyaṇī Mayī and Jagata Rāma added four Dhyānī Buddhas facing the four cardinal directions.
